name: Housing Assistance Ad Hoc Committee Liaison Meeting Agenda
agenda_text:
Beverly Hills City Council Liaison / Unhoused Services Ad Hoc Committee
  will conduct a Special Meeting, at the following time and place, and will address the
  agenda listed below:

  CITY OF BEVERLY HILLS
  455 N. Rexford Drive
  Municipal Gallery
  Beverly Hills, CA 90210

  IN-PERSON / TELEPHONIC / VIDEO CONFERENCE MEETING

  MEETING HIGHLIGHTS

  Thursday, June 22, 2023
  11:30 AM

MEETING CALLED TO ORDER
Date / Time:  June 22, 2023 / 11:30 AM

IN ATTENDANCE:  Mayor Julian Gold; Councilmember Lili Bosse; Nancy Hunt-Coffey, City
  Manager; Stephanie Harris, Community Services Director; Patty Acuna,
  Assistant Director of Community Services; Christopher Paulson, Human
  Services Administrator; Enisha Clark, Human Services Outreach Manager;
  Adam Falossi, BHPD MET Team; Lowell Rose, BHPD MET Team; Todd
  Withers, BHPD; Tod Lipka, President Step Up on Second; Kevin Conner,
  Lead Outreach Service Coordinator Step Up on Second; Melanie Cuevas,
  Step Up on Second; Abby Arnold, Consultant; Jenny Swan, Consultant; Al
  Poirier, Fire Department; Tiffany Davis, Christina Garcia, Program
  Operation Specialist; Linda Kyriazi, Management Assistant

  1) Public Comment
  a. Members of the public will be given the opportunity to directly address the
  Committee on any item listed on the agenda.
  Mark Elliot spoke on issues relating to rent burdened residents and resources to
  keep peopled housed.

  2) Community Education
  Enisha Clark, Human Services Outreach Manager, introduced Consultants Abby Arnold
  and Jenny Swan who provided information on the rights of Unhoused.

  3) Update on Enhanced Services to the Unhoused
  Christopher Paulson, Human Services Administrator, provided an update on the
  Enhanced Services since the City Council’s approval on November 15, 2022.
  - Implementation of a centralized 24-hour phone number
  - Implementation of a Software System (Apricot 360)
  - Expansion of Outreach Coverage
  - Consultant & Homelessness Plan
   -  Additional Service Enhancements and Collaboration:
  Kevin Conner, Lead Outreach Service Coordinator, provided information on the
  services that Step Up on Second provides in addition to the challenges they
  encounter.

  Todd Withers, BHPD, provided an update on the services the MET Officer Team
  provides.

  Consultants Abby Arnold and Jenny Swan have been meeting with stakeholders in
  addition to overseeing a survey. They’ll return with their proposed plan in a few
  months.

  Mayor Gold requested a push for a higher percentage response from residents.
  Councilmember Bosse requested that the software, Apricot 360, additionally log what
  services people are requesting. Staff is logging this information and it will be
  presented at the next meeting.

  Councilmember Bosse asked for an update on the two social workers that the
  County of Los Angeles is to provide. Stephanie Harris provided the update from the
  County that they are still in the hiring process.

4) Housing Opportunity – Step up on Second

  Following a presentation on a housing opportunity with Step Up on Second, City Council
  Liaisons provide direction to staff on the desire to bring forward a complete proposal for
  consideration to the full City Council to contract with Step Up on Second for scattered-site
  permanent supportive housing units for the unhoused for an initial 10-year term.

  City Council Liaisons agreed to bring to a Study Session in July 2023.

5) Adjournment

  Date / Time:  June 22, 2023 / 12:43 PM
